id: WIN-ID-13 (Windows pids: inventory reads an alive-unknown claude as unverified, never not running)
note: inventory <handoff> prints a `pid:` line with a live label for each live record of the handoff's session and a `claude_pid:` line for the handoff's claude_pid. Both are Claude Code's pids, under Git Bash's perl Windows pids, so inventory judges them with skills::ctx::liveness (identity::liveness) as record_live does, not kill 0. Seams as WIN-ID-01 (stand-in /proc, STORE_TEST_WINPIDS, STORE_TEST_PS_W, STORE_TEST_OS=msys; Windows pids above any Linux or macOS pid, so no real process can answer kill 0 for them): (1) a claude started from PowerShell, a WINPID only `ps -W` lists, is unverified in both lines, with or without a recorded start, never `no` or `not running`; a winpid that maps to a running MSYS pid (a claude started from Git Bash) reads yes with its start and start-differs with another, never no; an unlisted one reads no; (2) with no listing every Windows pid that maps to nothing is unverified; (3) control: a readable listing that no longer holds the PowerShell claude reads it as gone (no, not running); (4) a live record with an ended twin is not live (record_live), so its label comes from the pid alone: a PowerShell claude only `ps -W` lists reads unverified, not no, and no once the listing drops it; (5) macOS and Linux shape (no seams; needs unix-os, as under Git Bash's perl these steps would take the MSYS path and its real `ps -W`): kill 0 and the start time as before: yes, start-differs, no, running, not running
